<thought>To obtain the possible precursors, I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that matches the described carbonyl‑ene transformation (breaks a ketone C=O and an alkene C=C, forms a C‑C bond and a C‑O bond, and creates a five‑membered ring with an aliphatic hydroxyl). Then I will apply the found template to the target molecule to get all precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "C=C"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyl", "five-membered ring"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=C", "C=O"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (2.0->1.0)", "C=O (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
